camera._note: ONE camera for the whole future map. Never change these after the first render, or later stages will not line up with earlier ones.

pilot._note: Acropolis, Plaka, Thissio, Filopappou. 6 x 3 shots = about 1.8 x 1.3 km.

centre._note: Stage 2 example: Monastiraki, Syntagma, Kolonaki, Koukaki. Grows out of the pilot.

ring1._note: One ring of squares out from the pilot: Thissio/Kerameikos, Monastiraki-Omonia edge, Syntagma/Zappeio, Koukaki/Neos Kosmos. 10 x 7 shots, same centre as the pilot, so it contains it.

train._note: Extra render shots used only as training material, picked at random around the area.

lora.caption: isometric pixel art city map, flat colors, clean outlines

generate.negative_prompt: photo, photorealistic, blurry, noise, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, cars, people

tiles._note: Colour grade (+ optional pixel snap when snap_px >= 2) applied when building tiles; finished cells stay untouched, so this can be changed and re-run without redrawing. Setting D chosen 6 Nov: vivid, warm. Pixel snap turned off 6 Nov (smooth looks closer to the teacher drawings).

world._note: The whole map: Athens basin and around, from Salamina strait/Perama to Kifisia and east to Rafina/Mesogeia; chosen on limits.html 6 Nov. Undrawn squares are covered by fog of war on the site.
